# vendor/

`platform-capabilities.json` is generated by nooticr-server and copied here.
It is the only statement of which networks each backend capability can
actually reach, and it exists because this repo's descriptions drifted from
that code repeatedly — advertising platforms that were rejected, omitting
ones that worked, and describing a fast path as a ceiling — with nothing able
to notice, since the tests here compared this repo's files to each other.

Do not hand-edit it. In nooticr-server:

    UPDATE_PLATFORM_MANIFEST=1 cargo test -p nooticr-mcp --lib manifest_golden

then copy `platform-capabilities.json` from that repo's root into this
directory. A Rust golden test there fails if the file drifts from the
constants beside the dispatchers, so the copy is only ever as stale as the
last sync — which is what `tests/platform-claims.test.ts` reports on.
